description: The images and videos already in the user's iHatePosting library, newest first, with the `id` that create_post's `mediaIds` wants. Call this whenever a platform needs a file — Instagram, Pinterest, TikTok and YouTube all do — to see whether what you need is already uploaded. Returns ids and dimensions only; there is no downloadable link, by design.

limit.description: How many of the newest assets to return
